title: 世邦魏理仕 Zino Helmlinger：67%品牌仍想扩张，中国市场热度为何升温？
speaker: Helm Linger

segments.en: I think it's going to hold and it's going to accelerate very soon I found it very interesting when we were chatting just before this interview Telling me that you are looking at the busiest business periods in years
segments.zh: 我认为这一势头会保持，并很快加速。采访前聊天时，你提到正经历多年来最繁忙的业务期，我觉得很有意思。

segments.en: What's going on and you seem to be getting a lot of inquiries to expand in China now Okay, yes, as I said, CBRE retail
segments.zh: 发生了什么？你似乎收到大量咨询，想在中国扩张。是的，如我所说，世邦魏理仕零售业务……

segments.en: We've never been busier for the past 10 years So we actually have a CBRE service Where, you know, we investigate our retailers
segments.zh: 过去十年我们从未如此繁忙。我们有一项服务，会调研我们的零售商，

segments.en: And 67% of them want to expand in China right now While only 4% want to open less space in China
segments.zh: 其中67%现在想在中国扩张，而只有4%想减少在中国的空间。

segments.en: And are these foreign brands or domestic brands? These are foreign and domestic brands altogether Okay So we are starting to have a lot of heat regarding China
segments.zh: 这些是外国品牌还是国内品牌？两者都有。所以中国市场的热度开始上升。

segments.en: Because, you know, there's not much market that can provide depth, scale and stability Right now globally
segments.zh: 因为目前全球很少有市场能提供深度、规模和稳定性。

segments.en: And a lot of our, you know, clients have understood that So they are now planning to further accelerate China or penetrate China
segments.zh: 我们的许多客户已明白这一点，所以正计划进一步加速或深入中国市场。

segments.en: So yes, lots of heat is starting to come in And whether you're an international brand with, you know, no portfolio here Or whether you already have visibility in most of the major cities
segments.zh: 是的，热度开始涌入。无论你是尚未布局的国际品牌，还是已在多数主要城市有可见度的品牌，
